LanguageData.Raven_Omurice.label: [Raven] Omurice
LanguageData.Raven_Omurice.description: A delicious omurice made with unfertilized Raven spirit eggs. The egg is golden and tender, rich in nutrients and faint spiritual energy. Eating it brings a great sense of satisfaction.
LanguageData.Raven_Raven: A folk snack introduced from afar, widely praised among the Raven race. It features a sponge cake batter base filled with sausage and cheese, baked in a special mold. Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, with a rich filling and complex texture.
